slapd_user.description: System user account to run the slapd server under.

slapd_group.description: System group to run the slapd server under.

slapd_services.description: Space-separated list of listener URIs (e.g., 'ldap:/// ldaps:/// ldapi:///').

slapd_sentinel_file.description: Path to sentinel file; if it exists, slapd won’t start/restart via init script.

slapd_options.description: Additional command-line options passed to slapd.

pidfile_path.description: Path to the PID file for the slapd process.
